Thanks for the ping. High-level legal take:

- Recommend circulating our standard MSA with the DPA annex attached (single package). That allows legal teams to redline in parallel and reduces back-and-forth.
- We can accept an "order form effective upon DPA" clause for procurement to issue a PO, but we should include an express statement that commercial terms in the order form are not billable until the DPA is executed.
- Proactive asks: limit audit frequency to quarterly for pilot scope; set indemnity cap aligned to order value for pilot; add a 30-day warranty cure period rather than immediate termination on nonconformance — these reduce negotiation friction and protect our onboarding runway.

I'm attaching a redline of the MSA with those cleanups and a short comment summary. If Marissa can confirm whether finance requires pre-approved billing codes in the order form, we can finalize the orderform_draft.docx and share to Cardinal procurement.

Karthik
General Counsel, Redwood Inference
